method: We took portable ENERGY STAR dehumidifiers certified at up to 35 pints per day and compared the most efficient by IEF, scoring IEF and capacity. The five-year electricity cost is shown for each (certified yearly energy use x current EIA U.S. average residential price x 5). The list stops above a tie for the last place rather than picking among tied models.
name: Best small dehumidifiers (up to 35 pints a day), ranked by certified data
scoring: each value scored against the best on the page (best = 1), times its weight; total out of 100
